title: Understanding Test MSE
text: Test MSE is a measure of how well the model generalizes to unseen data. It can be affected by changes in model complexity.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding a new feature, such as the square of an existing feature, can increase model complexity. This might lead to overfitting or better capturing the data pattern.

title: Overfitting and Underfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model is too complex and captures noise in the training data, leading to higher test MSE. Underfitting occurs when a model is too simple and cannot capture the underlying pattern, also potentially increasing test MSE.

title: Analyzing the Effect
text: Consider how adding a squared feature might affect the model's ability to generalize. Could it lead to overfitting or better fit the data pattern?
